message.text: Cross-site scripting vulnerability due to a [user-provided value](1).
[Error information](1) can be exposed to an external user.

Cryptographic algorithm [DESede/ECB/PKCS5Padding](1) is insecure. It has a short key length of 56 bits, making it vulnerable to brute-force attacks. Consider using AES instead.
Cryptographic algorithm [DESede/ECB/PKCS5Padding](1) is insecure. ECB mode, as in AES/ECB/NoPadding for example, is vulnerable to replay and other attacks. Consider using GCM instead.
Cryptographic algorithm [DES](1) is insecure. It has a short key length of 56 bits, making it vulnerable to brute-force attacks. Consider using AES instead.
